name: sh.carbium/mcp
title: Carbium
description: Solana RPC and DAS reads, swap quotes, unsigned swap and DCA transactions, tokens, account usage.

environmentVariables.name: CARBIUM_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Service key for services.carbium.sh (RPC, DAS, quote, swap, prices). Optional: five tools work without it, quotes and the public RPC methods at 30 calls a minute per IP address.

environmentVariables.name: CARBIUM_ACCOUNT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Account API key for carbium.sh (usage, service keys, webhooks). Optional. Read-only unless CARBIUM_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES=1 and the key has full access.

environmentVariables.name: CARBIUM_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to list carbium_account_write (webhook pause, resume and test; key caps, limits, scope, allowlist; a free module plan). Off by default; a read-only account key is still refused.
